parameters: Duke Terenor's son, Randolf, has taken over what remains of his father's army.\! Men of Veridia, clean up this rabble so we can get on with more important matters.
Casamir. Men like you have no business in the game of war.\! We will show you how it works.\! Followers of Zanatus, we are to annihilate the enemy.
You bloody bastard...\| to hell with you!
Donari Temple. A concentration of lies.\! Show them no quarter. Strip this place of every icon, every text, every sign of life, and burn it to ashes.
